content.title: Nicotine Pouch Craze Lifts This Stock 80%, To Near A Buy Point
content.summary: The parent company of Zig-Zag rolling papers and FRE nicotine pouches is approaching a buy point. The stock is still up about 80% for the year, easily outpacing the 27% gain posted by the overall tobacco industry group.
